name: 34108 · Naples, FL
findings: ZIP 34108 (Naples) has 152 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (17%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34108 (Naples) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
